youtube_description:
Watch Kevin McCarthy, who works with the TOMODACHI Initiative, a partnership between the US-Japan Council and the US Embassy in Tokyo. She manages the TOMODACHI MetLife Women’s Leadership Program, which provides undergraduate Japanese women with mentoring from professional career women. Watch her full interview at https://www.careergirls.org/role-model/program-manager-kevin-mccarthy/.
